About

The person behind the profile.

Fig. 01 — subject, working session

I work in web and mobile development, mainly using React, React Native, and Supabase. I enjoy building clean, functional apps and solving real problems through code. I also have experience in cybersecurity — it's a field I'm passionate about and continue to explore. In 2022, I found and reported a vulnerability in TikTok, and since then I've been diving deeper into ethical hacking and digital forensics.

I've done freelance work building websites and apps, and I like being involved in every step — from planning and coding to testing and support. Tech support and troubleshooting are also things I'm comfortable with, and I genuinely enjoy helping people fix issues and improve their systems.

Right now, I'm focused on learning, building, and getting better every day at what I do.
